meta.title: StudioIA - Photorealistic architectural renders from your 3D model
meta.description: StudioIA turns a screenshot of your 3D model into a photorealistic architectural photograph, placing the exact real products you specify into each masked region - interiors or exteriors, up to 4K.

cap.title: Capabilities
cap.1.title: Mask-driven placement
cap.1.text: Paint a region, assign a real product from your library, and StudioIA places that exact item - matching perspective and light.
cap.2.title: Photoreal in one call
cap.2.text: A high-fidelity model renders up to 4K; switch to a faster model for quick, low-cost comparisons.
cap.3.title: Multi-angle consistency
cap.3.text: Pin any render as a style anchor so every other view of the space stays coherent and on-brand across angles.
cap.4.title: Preservation checks
cap.4.text: Automatic edge-IoU and object-inventory diffs flag when a render drifts from your original geometry - nothing sneaks in.
cap.5.title: Cost & metrics up front
cap.5.text: Per-render latency, token usage, and an estimated cost - so you always know what a render costs before you commit.
cap.6.title: Private to your account
cap.6.text: Your screenshots, product library, and renders are tied to your account and never shown to other users.
steps.title: How it works
step.1.title: Upload a screenshot
step.1.text: Drop in a screenshot of any view of your 3D model. StudioIA reads its exact resolution.
step.2.title: Mask & assign
step.2.text: Paint the regions to replace and assign each one a real product from your asset library.
step.3.title: Set the scene
step.3.text: Choose scene, lighting, materials, and any extra direction - interior or exterior.
step.4.title: Render photoreal
step.4.text: Generate up to four variations, keep the best, and reuse it as the anchor for other angles.
